This document mixes several element types in one pass: a blockquote, a code block, all heading levels, an inline image inside a paragraph, and a table with a native <caption> element (rather than a figcaption wrapper, as used in table.html). Here is an inline image in the middle of a sentence, testing whether inline images inside flowing text are detected as picture regions the same way a block-level figure is.

This is a blockquote. It should be tested for whether Docling assigns it a distinct label, such as a hypothetical "quote" label, or whether it collapses to plain text.

def greet(name):
    print(f"Hello, {name}!")

greet("world")
